name: Ultimate Redirect Manager
author: Abdur Rashid

sections.description:
Ultimate Redirect Manager is the most advanced redirection tool for WordPress. This Redirect tool will redirect your website’s error links and URLs to the pages you select. You can also track and manage 404, 301, 302, and “Page Not Found” errors very easily. Reduce errors and raise your site’s ranking with the aid of Ultimate Redirect Manager.

You can quickly and easily create and manage redirects without any prior knowledge of Apache or Nginx. Redirection can be used to redirect any URL if your WordPress site allows permalinks.

How to set Elementor 404 Page through Ultimate Redirect Manager

Features:

Custom 404 Page: Choose a custom page to serve as your 404 error page.

Manual Redirects: Set up manual redirects for specific source URLs to redirect to destination URLs.

Redirect Track: Redirect URLs will be recorded in the WordPress database for tracking and monitoring redirect links in the plugin dashboard.

User-Friendly Interface: Manage redirect rules through a simple and intuitive settings interface in the WordPress admin dashboard.

Usage:

Setting Up Custom 404 Page:

  1. In the WordPress admin dashboard, go to Settings > Ultimate Redirect Manager.
  2. Under the 404 Page Redirection section, select a page from the dropdown menu to serve as your custom 404 error page.
  3. Click Save Changes.

Adding Manual Redirects:

  1. In the WordPress admin dashboard, go to Settings > Ultimate Redirect Manager.
  2. Under the Manual Redirect Table section, you can add manual redirects by providing the source URL, destination URL, and redirect type.
  3. Click Save Rule to add the redirect rule.

sections.faq:
🔰 What is Ultimate Redirect Manager?

Ultimate Redirect Manager is a powerful WordPress plugin that allows you to manage various types of redirects on your website. It helps you handle 404 errors, create manual redirects, and improve overall site navigation.

🔰 Why should I use Ultimate Redirect Manager?

Here are some reasons to consider using this plugin:
-Custom 404 Page: You can set up a custom 404 error page to enhance user experience when visitors encounter broken links.
-Manual Redirects: Easily create rules to redirect specific URLs to desired destinations.
-Redirect Tracking: Monitor and analyze the effectiveness of your redirects.
-User-Friendly Interface: Manage redirects without needing technical expertise.

🔰 How do I set up a custom 404 error page?

-In the WordPress admin dashboard:
-Go to Settings > Ultimate Redirect Manager.
-Under the 404 Page Redirection section, select a page from the dropdown menu to serve as your custom 404 error page.
-Click Save Changes.

🔰 How do I add manual redirects for specific URLs?

Follow these steps:
-In the WordPress admin dashboard, go to Settings > Ultimate Redirect Manager.
Under the Manual Redirect Table section:
-Provide the source URL (the link you want to redirect from).
-Specify the destination URL (where you want visitors to be redirected).
-Choose the appropriate redirect type (e.g., 301 or 302).
-Click Save Rule to add the redirect.

🔰 Is Ultimate Redirect Manager easy to use?

Yes! The plugin offers an intuitive interface within the WordPress admin dashboard. You don’t need advanced knowledge of server configurations (like Apache or Nginx) to manage redirects effectively.

🔰How do I install Ultimate Redirect Manager?

Follow these steps:
-Unzip the plugin files.
-Upload the contents to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation.
-Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin panel.
-Configure your desired settings under Settings > Ultimate Redirect Manager.
